name: craft-agent-harness
description: Cross-platform capability, workflow, evidence, and agent harness

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:core && pnpm run build:plugin && pnpm run pack:plugin && pnpm run build:deepseek && pnpm run pack:adapters
scripts.build:plugin: esbuild bin/craft-mcp.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node23 --outfile=dist/plugin/craft-mcp.cjs && esbuild bin/craft-mcp-full.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node23 --outfile=dist/plugin/craft-mcp-full.cjs && esbuild bin/craft-mcp-http.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node23 --outfile=dist/plugin/craft-mcp-http.cjs && esbuild bin/craft-parser-worker.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node23 --outfile=dist/plugin/craft-parser-worker.js
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run audit:layering && pnpm run audit:surfaces && pnpm run audit:docs && pnpm run audit:consistency && pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:coverage-gates && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run test:plugin
scripts.test:plugin: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/release/check-plugin-package.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke/plugin-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke/plugin-component-smoke.ts && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/smoke/plugin-full-smoke.ts
scripts.eval:live: node --experimental-strip-types capability/craft-eval/run.ts && node --experimental-strip-types capability/craft-eval/recurrence.ts && node --experimental-strip-types capability/craft-eval/suite.ts
